title: Dark Shrine of Selfishness
wikitext:
[[File:Dark Shrine of Selfishness.png|right|120px]]
The '''Dark Shrine of Selfishness''' is an altar found in the [[Witch's Hut]]. It can be accessed after completing the [[Quests#Goblin Problem|Goblin Problem]] quest. The player can offer a [[Prismatic Shard]] to turn their children into doves, which permanently removes them from the game.

==Secrets==
After turning children into doves, two secret events may occur.

{{collapse|While watching TV...|content=
On the [[Farm Maps|Standard Farm]]: Watching TV on Fall 26 and choosing "???" will display an [[Ancient Doll]] on the TV screen, along with an eerie message:

{{Squote|You've brought this upon yourself... now I'm free... Hee hee hee!}}

After this message, an Ancient Doll will pop out of the TV.  Thereafter, there will be a cursed Ancient Doll in front of the Dark Shrine of Selfishness, which will fly around and attack the player.  When slain, this Ancient Doll will turn into a bird shadow and fly away.  Exiting and re-entering the Witch's Hut will respawn the doll.

On the [[Farm Maps|Four-Corners Farm]]:  Players may catch an Ancient Doll while fishing.

Note:  Killing this doll counts toward the [[Adventurer's Guild#Monster Eradication Goals|Monster Eradication goal]] of killing 200 bats, and [[Clint]]'s [[Quests#Cave_Patrol|"Cave Patrol" Special Order]] of killing bats as an option.}}

{{collapse|[[Telephone]] message|content=
If the player owns a [[Telephone]], they may receive a mysterious telephone call.
{{Squote|You place the receiver to your ear, and are met with a roiling, abrasive static. But wait... beneath it all, you can make out something else... an otherworldly voice... 'Y-O-U H-A-V-E F-O-R-S-A-K-E-N U-S'}}}}
